mentions.name: Focus Jar
mentions.description: A distraction blocker designed to be very hard to bypass that charges a real monetary fee if a focus session is cancelled early.
mentions.problem: Difficulty staying focused due to distractions.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://focusjar.app: a little app I built because my own focus was super wrecked lately. Basically a distraction blocker that is _really_ hard to bypass and makes you pay actual $$$ if you cancel a session early.
